content: Godato, hintewuka qassi salon Goday de7eysa eridi, hinte aylletas xillotethaninne issuwa issuwafe shaakonna koshshiyaba oothite.
Xoossay ba qaalas penge dooyana melanne taani hessa gaason qashon de7iya Kiristoosa xuuraa awaajana mela nuuska woossite.
Qassi taka besseysada qaala qoncisada odana mela taw Xoossaa woossite.
Injetiya wode ubbaa go7etishe ammanonna asaa matan cincatethan de7ite.
Hinte asa ubbaas koshshiya zaaro imo erana mela hinte oday ubba wode aadho keehatethan kumidaysanne maxineda mal7iyabaa gidanaw bessees.
Nu siiqo ishay Tikiqoosi, taara issife Godaa oosuwan aylle gidida, ammanetiya oosanchoy, ta de7uwabaa hintew odana.
Taani iya hinteko kiittiday, nu waanidi de7iyako hintew odidi hintena minthethana melasa.
Anasmoosi, ammanetiya siiqo ishay, hinte baggay, iyara hinteko bees. Enti haysan haniyaba ubbaa hintew odana.
Taara qashetida Arisxirokoosinne Barnabaasa ishaa na7ay Marqoosi, hintena saro yaagosona. Ta hintew kase odidaysada Marqoosi hinteko biiko iya mokite.
Yesuusa geetetiya Yasxoosi hintena saro saro yaagees. Xoossaa kawotethaa gisho taara oothiya asata giddofe Ayhude gididaysati ha heedzata; enti tana daro minthethidosona.
Hinte baggay, Kiristoos Yesuusa aylley, Ephafiri hintena saro saro yaagees. I hinte Xoossaa sinthan minnidi eqanaadanne Xoossaa sheniya eridi polana mela ubba wode Xoossaa hinte gisho woossees.
I hinte gishonne Loodoqeninne Hirapolisa kataman de7iya asaa gisho daro daaburidaysa ta markatayis.
Nu siiqo ishay dottorey Luqaasinne Deemasi, hintena saro saro yaagosona.
Loodoqen de7iya nu ishatas, Nimfaasinne I keethan shiiqiya asaas nu sarothuwa odite.
Ha dabdaabiya hinte nabbabidaape guye, Loodoqe woosa keethan nabbabisite. Hinteka Loodoqe woosa keethay hintew yeddiya dabdaabiya nabbabite.
Qassi Arkiphaasa, “Goday new immida oosuwa polanaysa dogopa” yaagidi qofisite.
Taani, Phawuloosi, ha sarothuwa ta kushen xaafas. Ta qashuwa qopite. Xoossaa aadho keehatethay hintera gido.
